title: se implementation scratchpad - verdant trust
content:
Context: Verdant Trust (regional banking customer) - POC -> private deployment behind VPC, dedicated GPU pool, must meet SOC2 controls and use KMS. Quick scratchpad of action items, config notes, and loose troubleshooting steps.

Goals for POC:
- Show sub-100ms median token latency for 2 concurrent qps on customer workload (50 token avg).
- Demonstrate model pinning + canary rollout (hosted->dedicated fallback policy).
- Validate network/VPC peering and key rotation with customer KMS.

High-level plan / milestones:
- Week 1 (2/15-2/21): initial infra deploy in their VPC (sandbox), basic smoke tests.
- Week 2 (2/22-2/28): performance tuning (batching, kv cache), run eval prompts.
- Week 3 (3/1-3/7): run security review, KMS integration test, final demo.

Current status: infra bootstraped (SE-3421) but VPC peering failing intermittently. Primary blocker: route table propagation / firewall rules expected by Verdant network team (ticket opened with infra: ENG-7891).

Immediate action items (owner / ETA):
- (Jordan) Re-run peering test w/ verbose tcpdump on bastion; capture SYN/RST behavior - due 2026-02-19 (blocked until network team confirms route).
- (Priya) Confirm customer firewall requires port 22 only from our jump host OR will allow management CIDR 10.64.0.0/16 - due 2026-02-20.
- (Miguel) Patch agent image to include debug binary (netstat, iproute2) and push new image tag se/verdant-debug:v2 - due 2026-02-21.
- (Jordan) Prepare demo script showing model pinning fallback: model=redwood-v1-3b -> pinned to quantized variant if dedicated capacity constraints hit. Mock failure scenario for demo - due 2026-03-03.

Notes / config snippets: (keep these handy)
- Terraform: verdant module vars
  - var.vpc_id = "vpc-verdant-sbx"
  - var.peer_account = "acct-verdant-03"
  - var.kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-verdant"

- K8s: deployment overrides for dedicated pool
  - nodeSelector: { "redwood/dedicated-pool": "verdant-pool" }
  - tolerations: "dedicated-gpu=true:NoSchedule"

- Runtime config (runtime.yaml snippet)
  - model_pin: "redwood-v1-3b-quant"
  - fallback_policy: ["dedicated-verdant", "hosted-general"]
  - batch_max_tokens: "512"
  - kv_cache_enabled: "true"

Troubleshooting checklist (VPC peering / network):
- From bastion: curl http://10.100.2.5:8080/health -> expected 200; if 404/timeout check security groups.
- tcpdump on eth0 on infra node while reproducing connection. Save pcap: /tmp/verdant-peer-YYYYMMDD.pcap.
- Check route tables for routes pointing to vgwy-verdant; confirm propagation to subnet-ids.
- Verify no implicit deny in customer ASA devices (asked network team to confirm).

Performance tuning notes:
- Start with batch_max_tokens 256, then test 100, 512 to find sweet spot for median latency.
- KV cache hit-rate critical for prompt-heavy flows (customer uses long system prompts) - suggest enabling prefix cache with 48h TTL for POC.
- Quantization: try int8 first (redwood-quant-int8) and compare token output quality against baseline; include eval script results in PR.

Demo checklist (for customer meeting):
- [ ] End-to-end request from Verdant app through VPC -> dedicated pool, show logs/tracing. (request id: demo-verdant-2026-03-05)
- [ ] Canary rollout scenario: show pinned model -> induce capacity constraint -> automatic fallback to hosted model.
- [ ] KMS rotate key demo: rotate key in staging and show agent picks up new key via secret rotation (verify audit logs).
- [ ] Cost estimate slide: committed monthly cost for dedicated pool + expected per-token delta vs hosted.

Open questions / risks:
- Customer requires HSM-backed keys for production - need SRE confirmation on HSM integration timeline. (raised to security: SEC-112)
- On-prem option considered later - scope creep risk if Verdant requests on-prem during POC. Keep conversation focused on VPC/private first.

Linked tickets and references (quick):
- SE-3421 (POC plan / onboarding)
- ENG-7891 (VPC routing issue)
- PR: infra#214 (node selector and pool config)
- Confluence: Verdant Trust Onboarding (contains network diagram)

Notes to self (quick):
- When demoing, always include a slide that shows trace of fallback happening (latency graph + token counts).
- Save perf runs in s3://redwood-poc-logs/verdant/2026-02-XX/ so we can link to Confluence.

Rough timeline for next week:
- Mon: finish peering testing + update ENG-7891.
- Tue: push debug image + run initial perf sweep (batch=128/256).
- Wed: integrate KMS rotation test in staging; verify audit logs.
- Thu: dry run demo with Priya + Miguel.
- Fri: customer sync (demo if infra stable).

If anything blocks >24h escalate in slack channel #se-verdant (thread id: slack:C07KJ1L9T/thread-4382).

Quick scratchy log (chronological):
- 2026-02-18 09:12 Jordan: spun up sandbox in their account, created vpc-peer-request-1234.
- 2026-02-18 11:40 Priya: customer network says routes showed up but traffic still blackholed. Asked for firewall ACL export.
- 2026-02-18 15:20 Miguel: uploaded debug image se/verdant-debug:v1.
- 2026-02-19 08:03 Jordan: tried tcpdump, saw SYN but no ACK from customer side - raised ENG-7891.

End of scratchpad. Keep this doc minimal and update as we move.
